title: Restriction to free coordinates
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $P\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$, and fix a sign assignment $z$ on $P$. The restriction of $f$ determined by $z$ is the function on assignments to coordinates outside $P$ that combines each such assignment with $z$ and evaluates $f$ on the resulting full assignment.
hypotheses_covered: sign-valued Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional cube
